finding_prior_axioms.claim: Axiom.prior_U_gap / Axiom.prior_S_gap (Reynolds' Prior-U / Prior-S) do not discharge BFMCS.LimitGuardEventual.
finding_prior_axioms.verification_status: HAND-CHECKED, NOT FORMALIZED. Formalizing needs a rational-flow semantics module this tree does not have. Recorded as unverified-in-Lean rather than asserted.
finding_prior_axioms.prior_U_from_below: Satisfied by the accumulating pattern: at t below the gap the antecedent U(top,psi) and F(neg psi) both hold, and the conclusion U(neg psi or K+(neg psi), psi) is discharged by the next guard-failure point, which the pattern supplies at every stage.
finding_prior_axioms.prior_S_from_above: Kills the ONE-SIDED pattern (guard failing cofinally below the gap while holding on an interval above it) but is silent on the TWO-SIDED one: if the guard also fails cofinally above the gap, Prior-S's antecedent S(top,psi) never holds near the gap. The two-sided accumulation satisfies Prior-U and Prior-S at every rational and has no definable gap in Reynolds' sense, yet BFMCS.LimitGuardEventual still fails at it.
finding_prior_axioms.consistent_with: BFMCS.LimitGuardEventual's own docstring, which already states its discharge is deferred and has no source in the corpus. This finding supplies the reason.

literature_grounding.quote: Call a linear temporal structure a Prior structure if it satisfies all substitution instances of Prior-U and Prior-S. It is easy to see that then there are no definable gaps. Note that this result does not hold for the original Prior axioms in the language of F and P.
literature_grounding.bearing: The Burgess-style F/P axiom (A7a) that powers his gap Lemma provably does not transfer to the Until/Since language; a strictly stronger axiom is required.

literature_grounding.quote: Prior-U:  U(T, p) & F~p -> U(~p v K+(~p), p) ; Prior-S:  S(T, p) & P~p -> S(~p v K-(~p), p)
literature_grounding.bearing: These are the repo's Axiom.prior_U_gap / Axiom.prior_S_gap; they are where the missing content would have to come from, and they do not suffice (see finding_prior_axioms).

literature_grounding.quote: we can define a coherent chronicle T* on (X*, R*) by taking T*(w(Y, Z)) to be some MCS extending C(Y, Z).
literature_grounding.bearing: C(Y,Z) is built from P-alpha and F-alpha only -- purely existential, with NO interval datum. His limit object carries no analogue of g(w,w'), so the guard obligation cannot even be posed in his construction. ADAPTED-FROM citation, as chartered.

literature_grounding.quote: All the systems discussed so far have been based on the primitives ~, &, G, H.
literature_grounding.bearing: The completion argument of section 2.7 runs entirely before Until/Since enter the language, confirming this plan's own literature note at the page.

literature_grounding.quote: Both proofs then finish off by applying a result of Kees Doets in [4] for finding a real-flowed model of the formula.
literature_grounding.bearing: Both established routes to real-flow completeness for Until/Since stop at a rational model and invoke Doets' theorem. Neither completes the rational model by inserting limit points at gaps, so neither incurs this obligation.

literature_grounding.quote: We have a temporal structure R, with flow of time the reals, satisfying the same monadic sentences of quantifier depth at most k as M does.
literature_grounding.bearing: The real-flowed structure is a DIFFERENT structure, only elementarily-equivalent up to quantifier depth k; no point of it is a limit of rational points.
